data.name: PonySide
data.detailed_description:
PonySide is a 2D top-down fantasy RPG that can be played solo or cooperatively with friends, set in a world shattered by the conflict of two powerful goddesses.

Create and customize your own unique character, choose your class, and step into a dynamic world where your path is entirely your own. Whether you prefer to adventure alone or join forces with others, PonySide offers an experience that flexes to your playstyle, challenging exploration, strategic combat, and meaningful choices await you.


You’re free to socialize with other players whenever you want: meet in lively towns, trade resources, chat, form parties for dangerous quests, or just relax together by a fire under a broken sky. If you’d rather go it alone, the world is fully playable solo, letting you uncover the truth behind the goddesses’ conflict at your own pace.

Discover ancient lore, survive corrupted lands, and carve out your own story in a realm shaped by divine rivalry.
